value="<b>What it costs.</b> Lambda: 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds free every month; a full 200-replay run takes a few minutes, a quick one about a minute. Scheduler: 14 million invocations free. Parameter Store standard parameters: no charge. Reports are a few KB in S3. With the AI writer, OpenRouter bills separately: a few dozen calls per run, cents. <b>The catch:</b> the Free plan closes after 6 months or when its credits run out, whichever comes first. div.div: What it costs. Lambda: 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds free every month; a full 200-replay run takes a few minutes, a quick one about a minute. Scheduler: 14 million invocations free. Parameter Store standard parameters: no charge. Reports are a few KB in S3. With the AI writer, OpenRouter bills separately: a few dozen calls per run, cents. The catch: the Free plan closes after 6 months or when its credits run out, whichever comes first. Upgrade to the Paid plan before then and the leftover credits carry over.
